source_identity_note: The recorded hashes identify the exact documentary source snapshots used for adaptation; they do not establish ownership or a distribution license.
extraction: Generalizes source fixed-order C6/C8 negative-pair, negative/kernel and stalled-kernel witnesses. No graph-family census, support-at-most-three generator, fixed dimension or native computation proof was copied.
new_api: Arbitrary finite index types and exact rational coefficients; real lower-bound and singularity semantics.
Strict dense length and sparse support validation; raw row-major integer matrix validation.
Arbitrary-k negative Gram certificates derive independence rather than assume it; dense/sparse column input with exact diagonal length.
validation: The recorded validation used Lean 4.30.0 and the package's pinned dependency cache. Tests use decide +kernel; audited public soundness theorems use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
limitations: No external byte/text parser is provided.
Subspace certificates require an orthogonal negative basis supplied by the producer; no discovery algorithm is included.
Sparse witnesses are evaluated via dense exact coordinates, so runtime depends on ambient dimension as well as support.
Without ambient symmetry, negative-index claims concern quadratic-form inertia. Kernel and two-vector checkers enforce symmetry.
